name: backseat
source:
you wake up in the backseat of a car... a friendly person is driving... you haven't felt so calm in ages... where are you two going?...

a short and sweet roadtrip dream.

[From [url=https://lenlen403.itch.io/backseat]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在汽车后座醒来…一个友善的人正在开车…你已经很久没有感到如此平静了…你们两个要去哪里？…

一个短暂而甜蜜的公路旅行梦想。

[来自[url=https://lenlen403.itch.io/backseat]itch.io[/url]]
